exceptions: emergency treatment up to the stage of stabilisation in case of an accident
expected.quote: Expenses incurred at an Excluded Provider shall not be payable, except that emergency treatment up to the stage of stabilisation shall be payable in case of an accident.
The list of Excluded Providers is available on the Company website at www.demogeneral.example/excluded-providers.

expected.valueText: The request states the room category for which authorisation is sought; authorisation is sought for the eligible category only where a higher category is opted
expected.quote: If the Insured Person opts for a room category higher than the eligible category, the Network Provider shall seek authorisation for the eligible category only.

expected.valueText: No deposit may be collected after cashless authorisation other than non-payable items, applicable co-pay and any amount in excess of the authorised amount
expected.quote: The Network Provider shall not collect any deposit from the Insured Person after cashless authorisation, other than non-payable items, applicable co-pay and any amount in excess of the authorised amount.

expected.valueText: Where cost is likely to exceed the amount authorised, the Network Provider submits a revised estimate with supporting clinical notes for additional authorisation
expected.quote: Where the cost of treatment is likely to exceed the amount authorised, the Network Provider shall submit a revised estimate with supporting clinical notes to the TPA for additional authorisation.

expected.valueText: Denial of pre-authorisation is not a denial of treatment or coverage; the claim is considered on merits on submission of documents for reimbursement
expected.quote: Denial of a pre-authorisation request shall in no way be construed as a denial of treatment or coverage, and the claim shall be considered on merits on submission of documents for reimbursement.

conditions: of receipt of the discharge request from the Network Provider
expected.quote: The Company or its TPA shall decide on a cashless pre-authorisation request within 1 hour of receipt of the complete request, and shall grant final authorisation for discharge within 3 hours of receipt of the discharge request from the Network Provider.

expected.valueText: If final authorisation for discharge is not granted within 3 hours, the additional hospital charges beyond that period are borne by the Company and interest is payable
